scope: Read-only source review and independent offline reread; no CLI/model invocation, no paid admission.

helper.privacy: Only hashes, lengths, counts and fixed interpretation returned; malformed payload errors generic. No prompt, thinking, tool arguments, settings values or unknown role strings returned.
helper.history: Current task occurrences collected in user messages; historical assistant messages are not labeled duplicate wake. Trailing native reminder does not imply task missing.
limits: textClassificationComplete classifies recognized message.content and reasoning_content representations; not a guarantee of all extension fields/tool argument semantics.
Task occurrence equality is literal substring evidence, not semantic instruction-following.
Hashes preserve JSON key order, hence unequal hashes do not by themselves prove unequal semantics.
No billing, token, transport completeness or fairness verdict is inferred.

verification: Reader reran byte length/SHA/private-file/seal checks; response SSE independently parsed, repeated identical usage deduplicated per response, response IDs unique per arm. Owner audit code inspected for server/old-observer cross checks.
preservedLimits: Synthetic business quality false retained; not paid efficiency acceptance.
P184 print native versus ACP is an end-to-end mode comparison, not matched-mode causal isolation.
P184 resume native permission reminders accumulate and dynamic tool schema changes remain visible.
Kimi corresponding settings differ only by native session prompt_cache_key in supplied exact-field audit; this free proof cannot retroactively prove paid P182 outgoing bodies.
Capture initialization failures preserved; process census must remain an external runner obligation because absence of initialized capture cannot prove no requests.
Tiny two-turn samples retain defaults but do not exercise long-context compaction.
